findings.evidence: The unquoted description contains 'Examples: <example>Context: User'. These colon-space sequences are invalid inside a YAML plain scalar, so the frontmatter does not parse and the host skips the agent.
findings.fix:
description: >-
  Create and compare low-fidelity ASCII UI wireframes for dashboards, forms,
  tables, navigation, and responsive layouts before implementation. Use when
  a user wants to visualize a screen, explore layout options, or revise a
  text-based mockup, even without explicitly requesting ASCII. Not for coding
  the interface or producing polished graphical designs.

findings.evidence: 'Break down the user's idea into core components, data relationships, layout constraints, and functional elements.' The body is dominated by familiar requirements analysis, rationale, selection, and implementation advice; its concrete output instructions provide activation rather than expert knowledge.
findings.fix: Compress the generic analysis, rationale, and implementation bullets into a short task contract. Replace the saved space with actual project conventions: supported viewport budgets, component and state notation, and approved layout patterns with their data-density trade-offs.

findings.evidence: 'Create 3-5 distinct ASCII mockup variations that explore different approaches to the same concept' specifies an outcome but provides no method for making alternatives meaningfully different or comparing them.
findings.fix: Add a decision sequence: identify the primary user task, rank information by frequency and importance, identify the dominant layout trade-off, generate alternatives that vary that trade-off, and compare all alternatives against the same task and density criteria.

findings.evidence: 'Focus on clarity, consistency, and practical applicability' supplies general aspirations, but the body has no concrete anti-patterns, reasons, or rendering gotchas.
findings.fix: Add a short Gotchas/NEVER section: never use tabs because tab stops can shift borders; never present diagrams outside fenced text blocks because rendering can collapse spacing; never mix variable-width Unicode glyphs into an ASCII-only diagram because displayed alignment can differ across viewers.

findings.evidence: 'Create 3-5 distinct ASCII mockup variations' is unconditional, including when a user requests one mockup or a focused revision of an existing choice.
findings.fix: Default to three alternatives for open-ended exploration, honor an explicitly requested count, and produce one focused revision when the user has already chosen a layout.

findings.evidence: No accompanying output eval was found for this agent; agents/ contains only Markdown agent definitions.
findings.fix: Add agents/evals/ascii-ui-mockup-generator.json with realistic dashboard and contact-form prompts plus an underspecified or narrow-screen case. Include expected outputs and verifiable assertions for required components, ASCII alignment, option counts, and selection or handoff behavior.

findings.evidence: 'When given a UI concept with data shapes and display requirements' assumes complete inputs. The dashboard and form examples reach the ordinary mockup-and-selection path, but the branch where data shapes or viewport constraints are missing has no stated fallback.
findings.fix: Define the incomplete-input branch: state reasonable assumptions and use labeled sample data when details are nonblocking; ask a focused clarification when a missing constraint would change the layout. Specify a default character-width budget and a reflow fallback when required content does not fit.
